semantics.timing: Combinational mapping with no clock, reset, storage, or extra latency.

verification.oracle: For each input bit i, expected output bit is ((3-(i//8))*8)+(i%8); derive from byte reversal in original problem.

verification.coverage: Directed distinct-byte patterns, all zeros/ones, walking ones/zeros, exhaustive byte values in each position, deterministic pseudorandom vectors and supplemental X/Z propagation.
